subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw pursue A2UI canvas apps as dashboard widgets through the bundled dashboard bridge, and should that wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 to define the canonical browser action-ingress contract first?
rationale: The request crosses product direction and a security boundary: it depends on unmerged dashboard widget work and would route sandboxed/browser-origin A2UI actions into trusted dashboard/Gateway paths.

options.title: Design after Canvas ingress
options.body: Keep this issue open and require the browser Canvas action-ingress contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 before implementing the dashboard bridge.

options.title: Sponsor a dashboard-first bridge
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly approve a dashboard-owned bridge first, but then it must define how it avoids diverging from the later Canvas web action contract.

options.title: Move out of bundled core
options.body: If this is not a bundled dashboard direction, route it to an external plugin/ClawHub package after any missing extension APIs are defined.

recommendation.title: Design after Canvas ingress
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require the browser Canvas action-ingress contract from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 before implementing the dashboard bridge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main owner signal for both the plugin-tab seam and the Canvas/security surfaces this decision crosses.
